params.body:
Tests for kubo-global/kubo-kolibri#8, which lets the bridge ask Kolibri for a learner's session as the admin instead of signing in with a derived learner password. The package's tests live in this app, so they come as their own pull request.

Merge kubo-global/kubo-kolibri#8 first: until it is on that repository's main, these tests call a method that does not exist yet and CI here stays red.

## Covered

- The client posts the learner's id to `/delegated-session/api/session/` with the admin's CSRF token and returns the two cookie values.
- The client returns null when the plugin is absent (404), refuses (403) or answers without a session.
- With `kubo-kolibri.delegated_session` on, the bridge uses the delegated session and never asks for a password.
- When Kolibri does not answer, the bridge falls back to the derived password.
- With the flag off, the bridge does not call the plugin at all.

No application code changes. Run against the package branch: 534 tests pass, 2 skipped.
params.title: Test the delegated Kolibri session and its fallback
